unit.why: A single narrative about R. Aharon, the Besht's brother-in-law, his opponent's death after excommunication, and dream appearances after R. Aharon's death.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי מהרב דקהלתינו שהיה ב קוטעב
stories.summary_en: An opponent of the Hasidim in Kuty pulls the beard of R. Aharon, the Besht's brother-in-law. R. Gershon excommunicates the man and he soon dies. After R. Aharon's death, R. Gershon spits at a husk (kelipah) that appears in a dream disguised as R. Aharon. R. Aharon then appears to R. Leib the Mokhiah in a dream and tells of the heavenly court case over the plucked hairs, of the lower Garden of Eden and his lonely Sabbath there, and of two thalers hidden for his widow, which are then found.
